name: @examples/extension-custom
//: The minimal non-built-in extension fixture Issue #85 hands to #86 (compile),
Deliberately empty: `@example/chart-kit` is decided `extension` by this project's
config, so the compiler's resolver hook answers the import from the extension's page
global before node resolution ever runs — the same property `examples/host-antd`
relies on for `antd`. Installing the package would be a silent escape hatch for a
broken interception: a missed mapping would then quietly inline an npm copy instead
of failing the compile, which is the state #12's non-goals forbid.
Nothing here claims the extension exists. #85 supplies the *configuration* path for
an extension this repository has not packaged; #88 is where a real one is validated
against a real designer, and `MangMax/forguncy-frontend-library` owns building it.
`@forguncy-react-workspace/core` is a devDependency because its only use is
`defineForguncyConfig` in the committed config, which the config loader imports — the
same arrangement `examples/dev-harness` records at length. The Cell's authored source
does not import `core`, so nothing in the artifact's module graph reaches it.
